scope: Only exact assets/contracts from approved HTX universe; compare corresponding external venue data, not arbitrary markets
required_use: Consider N05 only with useful comparable multi-exchange evidence close in strength and same direction
comparison_requirements: Exact same asset binding and compatible market type
Aligned complete windows, original source times and comparable units
Compare normalized directional imbalance rather than equal absolute turnover across unequal venues
Distinct actual exchanges; copied upstream response is not another exchange
Do not combine futures taker flow and onchain exchange deposits as one metric
Missing or incomplete venue data is not zero flow or agreement
Unresolved material contradiction is not a confirmed consensus

current_N05_sources.scope: Transaction facts,not an independent complete cross-exchange flow
